operations.label: GET an order
operations.detail: A safe read of one existing resource.
operations.retry: Retry within the caller deadline if the read is still needed; a new read may observe newer state.

operations.label: POST a payment
operations.detail: A non-idempotent request that can capture money once per logical intent.
operations.retry: Use a caller-scoped idempotency key and replay the original result for that key and request fingerprint.

operations.label: PUT a profile replacement
operations.detail: A replacement whose same representation can be applied more than once.
operations.retry: Retry the same representation if preconditions still hold; use an ETag when concurrent updates must not overwrite each other.

operations.label: POST an export request
operations.detail: A long-running request that should create one trackable operation, not repeat the work.
operations.retry: Return an operation ID. Poll or subscribe to its state; use the same idempotency key when the acceptance response is lost.

timeouts.label: Before the server receives it
timeouts.detail: The client deadline expires before the request reaches the request handler.

timeouts.label: While the server is working
timeouts.detail: The handler may still finish after the client gives up.

timeouts.label: After commit, before response
timeouts.detail: The server committed the result, but the client lost the response.

duplicates.label: No duplicate arrives
duplicates.detail: Only the original request is observed.

duplicates.label: The client retries once
duplicates.detail: A second request with the same intended operation reaches the server.

completionModes.label: Synchronous completion
completionModes.detail: The response represents the completed operation.

completionModes.label: Accept work asynchronously
completionModes.detail: The response confirms durable acceptance, then a separate operation state records completion.
